content: Is Ked-istudyu ni Daniel wey is menge Emiǥu Zin diyà te Babilonia
Hein iketelu he tuig te kedhadì ni Jehoyakim diyà te Juda, midsurung ni Hadì Nebucadnezar he hadì te Babilonia wey te menge sundaru zin is Jerusalem.

Mibihag din si Hadì Jehoyakim su iyan heeyan egkesuatan te Nengazen he mehitavu. Mibpenguwa zin is duma he menge azen diyà te valey te Megbevayà ne mid-uwit din diyà te Babilonia. Ne intaǥù din haazà diyà te teleǥuey te ketiǥeyunan diyà te valey he ed-ezapan te kandin he ed-ezapen.

Ne zutun, midsuǥù ni Nebucadnezar si Ashpenaz he pengulu te menge upisyal zin he mebpilì te egkepipira he menge vetan-en duen te menge vihag he menge Israilihanen. Heini he menge vetan-en kinahanglan he ebpuun diyà te lavew wey meupiya is dengeg he menge pemilya.

Heini sikandan, kinahanglan he menge mezagwey, meupiya is kedlelawa, memetau, elistu, wey melumu he ebpenuruen su para zait sikandan he ebpenilbi te hadì. Midsuǥù din daan si Ashpenaz he penurua zin sikandan te kineǥiyan wey belesahan te tig-Babilonia.
Ne insuǥù pa zutun te hadì he ebeǥayan sikandan kada andew te keenen din wey vinu. Ne emun egketapus en is tetelu he tuig, ne ebpenilbi en sikandan kandin.
Ne zuma zuen te nengepilì he ebpuun diyà te tribu ni Juda iyan ensi Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, wey si Azaria.
Ne mid-ilisan ni Ashpenaz is menge ngazan dan. Si Daniel ne iyan si Belteshazar, si Hanania iyan si Shadrac, si Mishael iyan si Meshac, ne si Azaria iyan si Abednego.

Piru midisisyun si Daniel he kenà sikandin egkaan te keenen te hadì wey kenà ed-inum te inumen te hadì, su para kenà sikandin meremeriki. Umbe midhangyù sikandin diyà te ki Ashpenaz he emun egkehimu ne kenà sikandin ipekaan dutun.
Ketau te Megbevayà he meupiya is isip ni Ashpenaz ki Daniel su para medtuǥut sikandin te hangyù din.

Piru migkaǥi si Ashpenaz diyà te kandin te, “Egkahandek a zuen te hadì. Su iyan sikandin migkaǥi ke hengkey is ibpekaan wey ibpeinum keniyu, ne emun egkeehè din he kenà mulà meupiya is keniyu he kedlelawa ne kela ke pehimetayi e zin.”
Ne migkeǥiyan ni Daniel is bantey he impeelima ni Ashpenaz kandin wey engki Hanania, Mishael, wey ki Azaria te,
“Gezami key pinaaǥi te kebeǥayi zà kenami te lumbey he egkekaan dey wey wahig he egkeinum dey seled te sepulù he andew,
ne ihindeg key zuen te zuma he menge vetan-en he iyan keenen dan is keenen te hadì. Ne ke hengkey is egkeehè nu he rimeǥas, ne iyan ke en metau ke hengkey is ebeelan nu kenami.”
Ne mibpezumazuma haazà is bantey he impeelima kandan ne migezaman din sikandan seled te sepulù he andew.
Ne kegkepasad te sepulù he andew, naahà he meupiya pa is kandan he kedlelawa kenà te zuma he menge vetan-en he keenen duen te hadì is kandan he keenen.
Umbe, impelaus en duen te vantey is kebpekeena kandan te lumbey ne wazè en leusa is kebpekeena kandan te keenen te hadì wey is kebpeinuma kandan te inumen din.

Mibeǥayan te Megbevayà heini is heepat he vetan-en te ketau lavew en diyà te nekedseselekawà he menge velesahan wey menge ketudluanan. Ne gawas kayi mibeǥayan din si Daniel te ketau wey zin ikeseysey is kehuluǥan te menge egkengelewasan wey menge teǥeinep.
Ne kegkepasad te tetelu he tuig he iyan insuǥù ni Hadì Nebucadnezar, ne mid-uwit sikandan ni Ashpenaz dutun te hadì.

Ne mibpekidlalag kandan haazà is hadì, ne naahà dutun te hadì he langun kandan te menge vetan-en ne wazà ebpekeiring engki Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, wey Azaria. Umbe iyan sikandan mibpilì he ebpenilbi kandin.
Dutun te langun he in-insà te hadì diyà te kandan, netuenan din he sepulù he takep is kedlavew te ketau zan te ketau te menge selemengkiru wey menge veyilan seled te tivuuk he ginhedian din.
Mibpedayun mebpenilbi si Daniel ki Nebucadnezar taman te nehuna he tuig te kedhadì ni Cyrus.
